What We Do

Our Services

End-to-end logistics solutions designed for speed, safety, and reliability.

Local Dispatch & Courier

Same-day pickup and delivery across Lagos. Documents, parcels, and packages delivered within hours.

Nationwide Delivery

Reliable cargo transport across all Nigerian states. Safe, secure, and timely delivery every time.

Park Pick-up: ₦12,500 Door-to-Door: ₦15,000
Security Escort Services

Professional security escort for high-value cargo, sensitive deliveries, and VIP movements. Discreet and reliable.

Vehicle Rental

Flexible vehicle rental for corporate and personal use. Clean, well-maintained fleet for short and long-term hire.

Same Day
Lagos ⇌ Ghana Express

Same-day air delivery between Lagos and Accra. One flight daily — book before 10:00am. No weight or size restrictions.

✈️ Via Air ⏰ Cut-off: 10am From ₦70,000
International Delivery

Cross-border logistics beyond Ghana — Africa and globally. We coordinate freight, documentation, and customs clearance.

DHL FedEx UPS ARAMEX

About Us

Building Relationships,
Delivering Happiness

Redwood Logistics & Transport Services is one of Nigeria's most reliable logistics companies, operating as a subsidiary of Danacko Group. From intracity dispatch across Lagos to same-day air freight between Nigeria and Ghana — we pride ourselves on speed, security, and customer satisfaction. One day. One flight. One promise delivered.

Same-day intracity pickup and delivery across Lagos.
